summary: Iteration 83: Daily.co calls (start/answer/end/decline/missed + system chat 'call' pill logs), DND (all-day, window-not-active, disable), Scheduled posts (visibility='scheduled', owner-only, cron auth, cron publishes due, past→public, invalid→400), Global back button. Backend 14/14 pytest passed. Frontend: 9 passed / 3 failed (2 real UI issues to report + 1 modal-close automation flake). Daily rooms are unique (no 'room already exists'), tokened URLs contain '?t=' for both caller and callee, and chat pills for missed/declined/dnd/ended are all rendered with 'Volver a llamar' redial button. DND toggle wires up correctly (dnd-settings, dnd-toggle, dnd-window with time inputs). Scheduled compose UI works (button → panel → datetime-local with min≈now+15min → submit navigates to /my-profile, clear button empties value).

ui_bugs.issue: global-back-btn NOT rendered on /website even though the page has no back/close control (query returns null). Expected per spec: 'Global floating back button on pages without the bottom nav'.

'Este live ha terminado' page shows only 'Ver otros lives' button; global-back-btn is not visible. Spec asks to report — reporting as absent. If considered a page without its own back control, FloatingBackButton should mount.

After creating a scheduled post via /compose (submit → navigation to /my-profile succeeds), no element matching [data-testid^='profile-post-scheduled-'] is found in the grid. Backend confirms the post is stored with visibility='scheduled' and /users/{me}/posts includes it for the owner, but the profile UI does not render the amber 'Programado' badge on the tile. Possible causes: default tab filters out scheduled/text posts, or grid rendering skips visibility='scheduled'.

action_items: Investigate why 'Programado' badge doesn't render on MyProfile grid after creating a scheduled text post (backend returns it correctly for owner via /users/{id}/posts and /posts/scheduled/mine). Likely a default-tab filter (Publicaciones vs Videos) or a filter that excludes visibility!='public'.
Ensure FloatingBackButton mounts on /website (page has no built-in back control). Verify OWN_BACK selector detection in FloatingBackButton.jsx isn't matching an unrelated element on WebsitePage.
Consider rendering FloatingBackButton on /lives/:id 'live ended' fallback screen so users can go back.
critical_code_review_comments: video_calls.py: end_call — when call.status is 'ringing' at time of /end, it correctly flips to 'missed' and calls _log_call_message. Good.
video_calls.py: _log_call_message computes duration from now - answered_at, which is safe since ended path only runs when status was 'active'. Missed/declined force duration=0. OK.

posts_feed.py: _publish_due_scheduled_posts rewrites created_at to now (so published post appears fresh in feeds). This may distort analytics — consider keeping original created_at and adding published_at only.
posts_feed.py: /cron/publish-scheduled uses hmac.compare_digest — good. Returns 200 + BackgroundTasks quickly — good pattern for cron.
utils/dnd.py is_dnd_active: when start==end and enabled=True, treats it as all-day DND. This is used by test payload {start:'00:00',end:'00:00'} — semantically consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 9/12 checkpoints passed; 2 real UI gaps (Programado badge, /website global-back), 1 modal-close automation flake unrelated to feature

seed_data_creation: Created ~4 scheduled posts by newtest (some published by cron, some remain scheduled) + a few call rows in fe8ed855 chat (ended/declined/missed/dnd). viewer2 DND left DISABLED as instructed. Total Daily rooms consumed during backend run: ~5.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend for Daily calls, DND, scheduled posts, cron is fully green — /app/backend/tests/test_iteration83_calls_dnd_scheduled.py is the regression suite. On the frontend: (1) the 'Programado' badge selector data-testid^='profile-post-scheduled-' was not found on /my-profile after scheduled compose — verify which grid tab renders scheduled posts and whether the current default profile view fetches visibility='scheduled'. (2) FloatingBackButton is not appearing on /website — inspect FloatingBackButton.jsx's OWN_BACK regex/selector list against WebsitePage DOM. (3) Chat has 20 call pills in fixture chat fe8ed855, all rendered as centered pills with 'Volver a llamar'. Redial + start-video-call-btn both open daily iframe with '?t=' token. To close the in-call-screen in automation, use page.evaluate to remove modal or set state, since call-hangup-btn is intercepted by an internal overlay in headless Chromium without WebRTC.
rca of the issue: Programado badge absence RCA: the MyProfilePage renders profile-post-scheduled-<id> only inside profile-post-<id> tiles produced by the Publicaciones/Reels grid. Repro: login newtest → /compose → schedule input to now+20min → text 'TEST_UI scheduled iter83' → submit → auto-nav to /my-profile → no scheduled tile visible. Mitigation: ensure profile posts loader fetches visibility='scheduled' for the owner (backend already returns them via /users/{id}/posts when current_user.id == user_id) and that the current default tab (Publicaciones) doesn't filter them out.
